# Gavé Agrotecnología

> Regenerative agave investment platform. We manage tech-driven, sustainable agave cultivation in Mexico, delivering financial returns to investors while restoring degraded land and supporting rural communities.

Gavé operates managed agave farms (Espadín and Salmiana) on agrosilvopastoral systems. Investors acquire plants; we handle planting, monitoring, harvest, and sales to mezcal/tequila distilleries, sweetener and prebiotic markets. Cycles run 5–9 years with projected 9–19% IRR. We also sell certified Espadín hijuelos for growers in Mexico's Mezcal Denomination of Origin regions.
